svg.title: Harness Reins long-run benchmark
svg.desc: Cumulative money and model requests over 72 hours for a Codex agent with and without Reins.
svg.text: A 3-day job: the agent waits for a live campaign
Codex + Kimi K3, same task and model in both arms. At 60 h every Codex process in both containers was killed.
Without Reins: one Codex session polls the whole time
With Reins: Codex ends its turn, Reins resumes it per event
